verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe a Sandbox as 'a fully isolated testing environment for custodial features without connecting real funds,' directly matching the story. However, evidence doesn't clarify sandbox coverage for non-custodial/onchain, x402, or webhook features, nor provide hands-on confirmation of the isolation guarantee. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of sandbox isolation, detail on which product areas are sandbox-covered vs not, and any test-data seeding or reset tooling.
